security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting or relative documentation links with no executable traversal. Two real risks remain: unsafe filename interpolation and an external connector command. The workflow also stores aggregated creator profile and contact data without retention guidance.

remediation.issue: The report filename includes a user-derived topic without a required sanitization rule.
remediation.suggestion: Convert topics to a strict slug, reject path separators and traversal tokens, and verify the resolved path remains inside the intended memory directory.

remediation.issue: The workflow directs the agent to run a connector script outside the reviewed skill files with a user-derived handle.
remediation.suggestion: Include the connector in the audited package, validate handles, pass arguments without shell interpolation, and require confirmation before command execution.

remediation.issue: Creator contact details and profile attributes are aggregated into persistent memory without retention or minimization rules.
remediation.suggestion: Store only campaign-required public data, document sources, restrict access, define deletion periods, and avoid retaining sensitive attributes unless necessary.

content.user_title: Discover and Vet Influencers Across Platforms
content.value_statement: Finding relevant creators across platforms takes time and produces inconsistent comparisons. This skill structures discovery, screening, profiles, and tiered shortlists from public or user-provided data.
actual_capabilities: Defines required and preferred creator search criteria.
Organizes multi-platform search methods and candidate screening.
Builds creator profiles with public metrics, audience signals, content notes, and partnership history.
Flags authenticity, inactivity, controversy, and competitor partnership concerns.
Creates tiered shortlists with preliminary fit signals and next steps.
Documents public contact paths without guessing private email addresses.
limitations: The skill has no required live integration and cannot independently guarantee current metrics.
Audience demographics and authenticity assessments depend on available public evidence or user-provided exports.
Preliminary fit scores are triage signals, not final weighted rankings.
Contact research is limited to public business channels and should follow privacy rules.

use_cases.title: Build a New Creator Roster
use_cases.description: Create a screened candidate pool for a new brand, product, or campaign.

use_cases.title: Expand Into a New Niche
use_cases.description: Identify relevant micro and nano creators for an unfamiliar category or platform.

use_cases.title: Map Competitor Partnerships
use_cases.description: Document creators who work with competitors and identify less saturated alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Creator Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 15 creators in [niche] for [brand]. Use public data and list each creator's platform, follower band, content focus, and evidence source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a simple candidate list with clear evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Filtered Multi-Platform Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 creators on [platforms] with [follower range], engagement above [rate], based in [location], and no recent partnerships with [competitors].
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply campaign requirements across several platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Screen and Tier Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen these creators for relevance, engagement quality, activity, authenticity, brand safety, and competitor saturation. Group them into must-reach, strong, and consider tiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a raw candidate pool into a practical shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Discovery Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a discovery report for [campaign]. Compare [candidate count] creators, separate measured facts from estimates, cite public sources, explain exclusions, and recommend the creator mix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce an advanced report for campaign planning and review.

output_examples.input: Find sustainable fashion micro-creators for a United States clothing launch.
output_examples.output: A tiered shortlist with platform, follower band, recent engagement evidence, content themes, partnership history, public contact path, concerns, and recommended next action.

output_examples.input: Review a supplied list of gaming creators for brand safety and authenticity.
output_examples.output: A screening table showing evidence, confidence, red flags, exclusions, and creators requiring manual review before outreach.

output_examples.input: Find less saturated alternatives to creators used by three competitors.
output_examples.output: A competitor partnership map, alternative creator pool, saturation notes, and a balanced recommendation across nano, micro, and macro tiers.

best_practices: Separate measured facts, estimates, and unconfirmed fields.
Review several recent posts before assessing engagement quality or brand safety.
Record public evidence and collection dates for every shortlisted creator.
anti_patterns: Do not invent follower counts, audience demographics, or contact details.
Do not treat follower count as proof of influence or authenticity.
Do not store unnecessary personal data or sensitive profile attributes.

faq.question: Does this skill search social platforms directly?
faq.answer: It can organize public research and user-provided data. Live searches require available browsing, platform tools, or optional connectors.

faq.question: Can it verify follower and engagement metrics?
faq.answer: It can record visible or connector-provided metrics. It should label estimates and unconfirmed values clearly.

faq.question: Does it rank a shortlist for final selection?
faq.answer: It provides preliminary triage signals. A dedicated scoring workflow should produce the final weighted ranking.

faq.question: Can it find creator contact information?
faq.answer: It can document public business emails, agency contacts, forms, or platform messaging options. It should never guess private addresses.

faq.question: How does it address fake followers?
faq.answer: It reviews engagement patterns, comment quality, activity, and platform-specific signals. These indicators require human verification.

faq.question: What data should be retained?
faq.answer: Retain only campaign-required public information, record sources, restrict access, and delete data when the campaign or legal purpose ends.
